comparison.objective: Choose and install the matching driver bit, power-tighten a drawer knob, and return the stopped tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Shape-based tool selection, bit insertion, screw engagement, powered axial feed, bracing, and tool placement.
comparison.success_condition: Correct bit remains mounted, powered tightening closes and load-tests the knob, and the stopped driver is released stably in its stand.
comparison.reason: Tool assembly and powered screw driving are different from rail-end mating and bearing-block transfer. Shared insertion/alignment primitives do not establish overlap.
